Save iNaturalist images and reproducible local metadata

Source: R/inat_images.R
inat_save_images.Rd

Downloads the primary photograph and, when requested, all auxiliary photographs associated with selected iNaturalist observations. Each observation receives a JSON metadata file containing the standardised taxonomic, licensing, locality, observer, and source-URL information required to reproduce the corresponding scientific figure without querying the web again. The iNaturalist API is intended for small or medium requests; use observation exports for bulk extraction. See https://www.inaturalist.org/pages/api+recommended+practices.

inat_save_images(
  species = NULL,
  user_id = NULL,
  number_observations = 1L,
  observation_id = NULL,
  image_size = NULL,
  include_auxiliary = FALSE,
  directory = getwd(),
  quality_grade = NULL,
  place_id = NULL,
  catalogue_dataset = NULL,
  language = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  refresh = FALSE,
  taxon_id = NULL
)

Arguments

species

Optional scientific name, normally written as "Genus species". It is matched exactly (case-insensitive) to a species-rank taxon. Supply either species or taxon_id; observation_id may be used alone or with either selector.

user_id

Optional iNaturalist login used to restrict a species search. NULL includes observations from all users.

number_observations

Positive integer giving the maximum number of observations to retrieve; defaults to 1.

observation_id

Optional iNaturalist observation identifier or vector of identifiers. When supplied with species or taxon_id, the taxonomic identity is verified; when supplied alone, all identifiers are cross-checked against a single common taxon.

image_size

Image variant: "medium", "large", "original", "small", or "square". When omitted, the function uses the configured image size; for inat_images() and inat_images_md() this is default_image_size, initially "medium". inat_save_images() uses default_save_image_size, also initially "medium".

include_auxiliary

Logical; save all photographs of each observation when TRUE, or only the primary photograph when FALSE (default).

directory

Base directory under which the package creates or searches sacha_exports/Family_Genus_species/inat. Defaults to the working directory. Existing archives in the former images directory and earlier taxon-directory layout remain readable when using the default path.

quality_grade

iNaturalist observation quality filter. When omitted, the configured default_quality_grade is used (initially "research"). Valid API values are "research", "needs_id", and "casual".

place_id

Optional numeric iNaturalist place identifier.

catalogue_dataset

ChecklistBank dataset identifier used to obtain taxonomic authorship. When omitted, the configured dataset is used (initially "3LXR").

language

Caption language. When omitted, the configured iNaturalist language is used (initially English). Spanish and other installed inst/lang language files are also accepted.

overwrite

Logical; overwrite existing local image files.

refresh

If TRUE, bypass cached API results.

taxon_id

Optional positive iNaturalist taxon ID (numeric or numeric text) at species rank. It queries that taxon directly without resolving a name. Observations are checked against the exact taxon ID. Local searches use the saved taxon ID and retain the existing directory structure.

Value

A data frame documenting saved observations, folders, metadata files, and the number of successfully available images.

Details

Images and their metadata are organised under sacha_exports/Family_Genus_species/inat/ within directory, preserving the package's taxonomic directory convention while separating iNaturalist files from exports produced by other package modules.

When omitted, image_size, quality_grade, catalogue_dataset, and language use the active iNaturalist settings from sacha_configure(inat = ...). For this function, image_size follows default_save_image_size (initially "medium"). An explicit function argument takes precedence over sacha_arg_configure(); a shared argument default takes precedence over the module setting.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
inat_save_images("Bidens andicola", user_id = "marceloamores")
inat_images("Bidens andicola", user_id = "marceloamores",
            source = "local")
} # }
